Auralyn vae mirael

pkg.sunoStyle: fantasy ambient EDM, cinematic, ethereal, epic, immersive, grand. Instruments: ambient pad, ethereal lead, orchestral strings (wide, warm, layered), choir (full, evolving, massive), soft low brass (sustained), distant low rumble (irregular, no attack, long decay). Sound: deep reverb, long delay, wide stereo, no drums, no percussion, no beat, low end far, diffused, arrhythmic, mid-low filled by strings, choir, brass, slow evolving layers, stable tempo. Vocal: female soft whisper (airy, breathy, distant, layered, reverb-heavy), male deep whisper (low, dark, slow, minimal, distant). Humming: very soft, wide stereo, background only. Language: fantasy only (female = vowel flow, male = consonant rhythm). Structure: alternating whispers then collision or embrace at drop. Drop: energy wave expansion, cinematic, no rhythmic impact. Tempo: 70 BPM, no acceleration. Restrictions: no singing style, no clear vocal lead, no drums, no groove, no rhythmic bass.
